title: Economic Fury Targets Illicit Oil Smuggling Network Run by Iranian Regime Elite
summary: OFAC sanctioned more than two dozen individuals, companies, and vessels in the Shamkhani network—an Iranian oil shipping empire run by Mohammad Hossein Shamkhani (son of former senior Iranian security official Ali Shamkhani)—as part of the 'Economic Fury' maximum pressure campaign. The action also targets a Hizballah-linked gold scheme involving Venezuelan gold in exchange for Iranian oil, allegedly on behalf of IRGC-QF. Since President Trump's NSPM-2 issuance, OFAC has sanctioned over 1,000 persons, vessels, and aircraft targeting Iranian oil sales and proxies.
key_points: OFAC designated over two dozen entities including UAE-based shipping firms (House of Shipping, Taylor Shipping, Corplinx Consultancy), commodity trading companies (Oriel Group), and vessel management companies linked to Shamkhani's network
The Shamkhani network allegedly generates billions of dollars for Iranian and Russian regimes through crude oil, oil product, and LPG tankers
Vessel AURA (IMO 9274563) transported over 3 million barrels of Iranian LPG since early 2025 as part of the fleet
A Hizballah financier and three companies were designated for a money laundering scheme involving Iranian oil exchanged for Venezuelan gold on behalf of IRGC-QF
Actions taken pursuant to E.O. 13902 (Iran sanctions authority) and E.O. 13224 (counterterrorism authority, as amended)
Since NSPM-2 issuance, OFAC has sanctioned over 1,000 persons, vessels, and aircraft targeting Iranian oil sales and proxies
why_it_matters: These sanctions directly target Iran's shadow fleet and oil export infrastructure under the 'Economic Fury' maximum pressure campaign. Secondary sanctions exposure for financial institutions increases, particularly for parties facilitating Iranian oil transactions through the Shamkhani network or associated front companies. The action explicitly includes LPG tankers alongside crude carriers, expanding enforcement scope beyond prior crude-focused rounds.
macro_context: Iran is a significant LPG exporter, and sanctions on the Shamkhani network's LPG fleet could affect regional energy supply dynamics if enforcement is effective. The Treasury action signals continued maximum pressure on Iranian oil revenue. Actual market impact depends on enforcement effectiveness and whether Russian partners continue to facilitate the network.
market_structure_context: The Shamkhani network uses multiple UAE-based front companies (Oriel Group, House of Shipping, Taylor Shipping, Corplinx) and vessel management firms to obscure ownership and operations. The network's vessels carry Iranian crude, oil products, and LPG to various destinations including East Asia. Vessel AURA transported over 3 million barrels of Iranian LPG since early 2025. Secondary sanctions risk affects any financial institutions processing transactions for these entities.
important_numbers: 1,000+ persons, vessels, and aircraft sanctioned since NSPM-2
3+ million barrels of Iranian LPG transported by AURA since early 2025
tens of millions of dollars in vessel construction payments by Meritron
E.O. 13224 (counterterrorism authority, as amended by E.O. 13886)
